page.layout: One column of running text, left of centre, with a wide empty space to its right. No marginal notes. Running head "NOTÆ." with page number "51" at top right. Catchword "cenorum" at bottom right and signature "H 3" at bottom left.

main_text.l: Abd Manapho natus in linea recta هاشم Hafhem, qui
populi sui princeps fuit, ac primus الرحلتين [?] i. e.
binas pabulatorum catervas, æstivam, &c. & hyber-
nam, quarum in Alcor: fit mentio, apud eos instituit.
Extra lineam 1. عبد شمس Abd Shems qui pater
امية Ommaiya, à quo Ommawaide, è quibus Othman
Ebn Affani. Nec-non Moawiah Ebn Abi Sofyan, &
1. المطلب AlMotallab, à quo المطلبيون Motalla-
bidæ. E quibus fuit Antistes sectæ Shafiensis, &c. Mo-
hammed, Ebn Edrü, Ebn il Abbas, Ebn شافع Sha-
fei, &c.
3. ذو فل Nawfal, A quo النوفليون Nawfalidæ.
Hashemo natus in linea recta عبد المطلب Abdol Mo-
tallab. eAbdo'l Motallabo عبدالله Abdollah, in linea rec-
ta. extra lineam omnes patrui Mohammedis, &c.
حمزة Hamzah, العباس AlAbbas, à quo Chalifæ Abbasidæ
genus ducunt. ابو طالب Abu Taleb pater Alii, ابو
لهب Abu Labeb. الغيداق AlGidak, الحارث AlHa-
reth, جحل Jabel, المقوم AlMokawan, ضرار Ddo-
rar. الزبير AlZobair, قثم Ketham, عبد
الكعبة Abdo'l Caaba. Abdollahi filius Mohammedis, qui natus
anno الفيل i. e. Elephanti, quæ Arabum ante Hejram
Atque hæ præcipuæ sunt Arabum antiquiorum tri-
bus. Ego certe Maimonidi inter eos qui non magni
sint momenti, quibusque pervolvendis non multum
insumi debeat temporis, libros, إنساب
العرب i. e. Origines Arabum numeranti facile assenserim, quas ta-
men hoc loco qua potui fide ex Ismaele Abulfeda &
Shahaboddino Ahmede Ebn Yahya aliisque ut referrem
eo inductus sum, quod scribit ille, qui Chronicon Sara-

page.notes: Arabic words are copied as far as legible; the spelling of the Arabic names, especially الرحلتين, is doubtful and not verified letter by letter. Italic and roman distinctions in the Latin are approximate. The page has no marginal notes. The bottom line "cenorum" is taken as the catchword.
